audit_name: Multi-Role Privileged Operator Approval Workflow Audit

role_definitions.RESEARCH_OPERATOR: Can draft and submit observation proposals. Cannot approve any proposal.
role_definitions.APPROVAL_ADMIN: Can approve proposals submitted by other operators. Cannot approve own proposals. Can revoke approvals.
role_definitions.AUDITOR: Strictly read-only inspection of proposals, approval records, tokens, and audit trails. Cannot submit or approve.
